meta.comment: engine.traffic (planned MOD) inc0 table (c): vehicle capacity + occupancy + energy + parking-footprint + road-wear-input table. Fields here NEVER restate data/modes.json's capacityPerUnit/pcuLoad/speedUrbanKmh (GR#3) -- every row keys to a modes.json mode id via refinesModeId where one exists, and carries only NEW figures modes.json does not: avgOccupancyPersons (actual average riders per vehicle-trip, a demand-realised figure, distinct from modes.json's seat-capacity range), fuel/energy consumption per km, parking footprint, and (for road vehicles) a reference to its road_wear.json ESAL factor. Four bus SUBTYPES (minibus/single-deck/double-deck/articulated) refine data/modes.json's generic 'bus' mode id, per Aaron's brief -- modes.json's own 'minibus' mode id (14-seat, nested-logit demand alternative) is a SEPARATE choice alternative from the operational 'minibus'-CLASS bus vehicle here (16-seat PSV, UK-standard minibus PSV category); the two numbers legitimately differ because they measure different things (a discrete demand-choice option vs. a physical fleet vehicle spec) and this file says so explicitly per row to avoid a silent GR#3 contradiction.
meta.unitsConvention: avgOccupancyPersons = average persons actually riding per vehicle-trip (dimensionless, persons); fuelLitresPerKm / kWhPerKm = litres or kWh consumed per vehicle-km; parkingFootprintM2 = square metres of parking/stand footprint per vehicle; esalFactor cross-references road_wear.json's canonical value (not restated, this file's esalFactor fields are OMITTED -- see road_wear.json).

avgOccupancyPersons.note: Falls slightly with density (solo-commute pressure); UK DfT NTS0905 all-purpose car occupancy ~1.5-1.6 national average, this schema's urban range trends lower.
avgOccupancyPersons.confidenceNote: the NATIONAL average is measured; the density-adjustment slope applied per rung is derived

avgOccupancyPersons.source: derived approximation (mostly single/couple fares, occasional shared)

roadVehicles.name: Cargo van

avgOccupancyPersons.note: driver only, this is a FREIGHT vehicle not a modes.json passenger mode

roadVehicles.source: UK DfT freight vehicle category (van, GVW <=3.5t)

roadVehicles.name: Rigid truck
roadVehicles.confidenceNote: UK HGV weight-category bands are measured/regulatory; the mid-point capacityTonnes and fuel figure are derived

roadVehicles.name: Articulated truck
roadVehicles.source: UK DfT HGV weight categories (articulated, up to 44t GVW, ~26t payload)
roadVehicles.confidenceNote: regulatory weight cap measured; payload/fuel figures derived

busSubtypes.$comment: Refine data/modes.json's generic 'bus' mode id (capacityPerUnit 80, pcuLoad 2.0 -- unchanged, referenced not restated). Real-world UK PSV category capacities, mapping sanity-check only.

minibus.note: 16-seat PSV minibus (UK category); distinct from modes.json's separate 'minibus' MODE id (14-seat nested-logit demand alternative) -- both numbers are legitimate real-world PSV variants, kept distinct to avoid overwriting modes.json (GR#3).
minibus.confidenceNote: category seat range is a regulatory/industry norm (measured); load factor is derived

single_deck.note: Standard UK single-deck PSV. totalCapacity 70 is Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0 description: 'single-deck 70'); seatedCapacity/standingCapacity are a derived apportionment of that total to a plausible UK single-deck split (seated 45 sits within the ~40-45 range typical of a UK single-decker), not an independent measurement, and sum exactly to totalCapacity (BUG-821).
single_deck.source: totalCapacity: Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0); seated/standing split: derived apportionment, mapping sanity-check only against UK PSV single-deck norms
single_deck.confidenceNote: totalCapacity is the brief-specified anchor figure; the seated/standing split is this schema's own derived apportionment, not independently sourced -- downgraded from measured per BUG-821

double_deck.note: Standard UK double-deck PSV. totalCapacity 90 is Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0 description: 'double-deck 90'); seatedCapacity/standingCapacity are a derived apportionment of that total to a plausible UK double-deck split (seated 78 sits within the ~75-80 range typical of a UK double-decker), not an independent measurement, and sum exactly to totalCapacity (BUG-821).
double_deck.source: totalCapacity: Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0); seated/standing split: derived apportionment, mapping sanity-check only against UK PSV double-deck norms
double_deck.confidenceNote: totalCapacity is the brief-specified anchor figure; the seated/standing split is this schema's own derived apportionment, not independently sourced -- downgraded from measured per BUG-821

articulated.note: Bendy-bus / BRT articulated PSV, higher road footprint than a rigid double-deck hence the pcuLoad override. totalCapacity 120 is Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0 description: 'artic 120'); seatedCapacity/standingCapacity are a derived apportionment of that total to a plausible articulated split (seated 49 matches the typical UK/EU bendy-bus seated figure, with the high standing remainder reflecting an articulated PSV's floor-area-to-seat ratio), not an independent measurement, and sum exactly to totalCapacity (BUG-821).
articulated.source: totalCapacity: Aaron's brief anchor (FEAT-2326609792 inc0); seated/standing split: derived apportionment, mapping sanity-check only against UK/EU articulated bus capacity norms
articulated.confidenceNote: totalCapacity is the brief-specified anchor figure; the seated/standing split is this schema's own derived apportionment, not independently sourced -- downgraded from measured per BUG-821

provenance.source: UK DfT vehicle/HGV weight category statistics, UK PSV capacity norms, DfT NTS0905 car occupancy (measured), remaining rows derived approximations
provenance.note: Mixed-confidence file; each row states its own confidence per GR#15/inc0's provenance mandate. No value here duplicates a data/modes.json, data/roads.json, data/freight.json, or data/fuel.json numeric field -- see traffic-assumptions.md A-2 for the no-duplication audit.
